spec.description: Grafana dashboard for Angie (fork of nginx) web server metrics

spec.title: New Connections
spec.description: Accepted/Dropped Connections

spec.title: Zone Received Requests
spec.description: Number of client requests received in an HTTP server zone (per second)

spec.title: Requests In Progress
spec.description: Number of client requests currently being processed in an HTTP server zone

spec.title: Location Zone Received Requests
spec.description: Number of client requests received in an HTTP server zone (per second)

spec.title: Zone Discarded Requests
spec.description: Number of client requests completed in an HTTP server zone without sending a response (per second)

spec.title: Location Zone Discarded Requests
spec.description: Number of client requests completed in an HTTP server zone without sending a response (per second)

spec.title: Connections
spec.description: Active and Idle Connections (stacked)

spec.title: Server Zone Responses - 2xx/3xx Codes
spec.description: Count of responses with 100-399 Status Codes (per second)

spec.title: Server Zone Responses - 4xx Codes
spec.description: Count of responses with 400-499 Status Codes (per second)

spec.title: Server Zone Responses - 5xx Codes
spec.description: Count of responses with 500-599 Status Codes (per second)

spec.title: Upstream Requests In Progress
spec.description: The number of requests currently being processed by an upstream peer in "HTTP"

spec.title: Upstream Health Failures
spec.description: Number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with an upstream peer in "HTTP".

spec.title: Upstream Keepalive Connections
spec.description: The number of currently cached keepalive connections for an HTTP upstream.

spec.title: Upstream Requests
spec.description: Number of attempts to use an upstream peer in "HTTP" (per second)

spec.title: Upstream Health Unavailable Events
spec.description: Number of times when an upstream peer in "HTTP" became "unavailable" due to reaching the max_fails limit.

spec.title: 5xx Error Rate
spec.description: Amount of 5xx errors codes divided by all zone requests

spec.title: 4xx Error Rate
spec.description: Amount of 4xx errors codes divided by all zone requests

spec.title: Location 4xx Error Rate
spec.description: Amount of 4xx errors codes divided by all location zone requests

spec.title: Location 5xx Error Rate
spec.description: Amount of 4xx errors codes divided by all location zone requests

spec.title: Peer 4xx Error Rate
spec.description: Amount of 4xx errors codes divided by all location zone requests

spec.title: Peer 5xx Error Rate
spec.description: Amount of 4xx errors codes divided by all location zone requests

spec.title: HTTP Cache Processed Responses
spec.description: Number of responses processed in an HTTP cache zone with a specific cache status (per second)

spec.title: HTTP Cache Processed Data
spec.description: Number of bytes processed in an HTTP cache zone with a specific cache status. (per second)

spec.title: HTTP Cache Written Data
spec.description: Number of bytes processed in an HTTP cache zone with a specific cache status. (per second)

spec.title: HTTP Cache Written Responses
spec.description: Number of responses written to an HTTP cache zone with a specific cache status (per second)

spec.title: HTTP limit_conn Requests
spec.description: Number of requests processed by an HTTP limit_conn zone with a specific result (per second)

spec.title: HTTP limit_reqs Requests
spec.description: number of requests processed by an HTTP limit_reqs zone with a specific result (per second)

spec.title: Zone Received Connections
spec.description: Number of client connections received in a stream server zone (per second)

spec.title: Connections In Progress
spec.description: Number of client connections currently being processed in a stream server zone

spec.title: Zone Discarded Connections
spec.description: Number of client connections completed in a stream server zone without establishing a session (per second)

spec.title: Angie
